explication: Apache DataFusion Comet is a drop-in accelerator for Apache Spark SQL: Spark plans are selectively converted to Comet operators, serialized across JNI, and executed on Arrow columnar batches using Rust/DataFusion or JVM Arrow code. The main result path includes planning, expression/operator execution, Parquet and Iceberg access, and columnar shuffle or broadcast. Additional documented capabilities include aggregations, joins, and Scala/Java UDF support. README documents the product-level flow; source excerpts and the index provide evidence for selected internal links, while some subsystem details are unsampled.
